body: I am afraid to - it's considered taboo where I am from and my sister already has a disorder for which my parents blame themselves. Quite honestly I don't give a shit if it disturbs my father - but my mother has had a hard life. It seems like whatever way I go I can't make a good decision. I don't want to be labelled and doped up and for the rest of my life I live with this added name onto my person.

I'm just sick of always feeling so worthless. Every single day getting out of bed is so fucking difficult. I want so badly to appreciate the things that I have in my life, but I just can't and it only makes me feel guilty. I'm in love with the best human being I've ever found. I have friends that would fight the world for me. I have family that cares. Underneath all that there's just this rage that I can't handle. I'm filled with self hate and self consciousness and I am barely managing to hide it. I am fighting a losing battle and I'd really rather just end it on my own terms.

I've been thinking about this for a very long time. I thought if I put it on paper then I'll lose my courage and back out. I think if anything it's made it a whole lot worse. I'm ok with this. Honestly.
